notice: SYNTHETIC evaluation queries written for this take-home. Each query paraphrases a scenario (different wording from the knowledge base) and lists the historical claims a human would consider relevant.

queries.query: Upstairs neighbour's bathroom pipe gave way and water is coming through my ceiling near the lamp
The hose of my washing machine split and the kitchen floor is soaked, the flat below has a stain
Strong gale ripped tiles off the roof and rain is now leaking into the loft
Grease in the frying pan caught fire, kitchen cupboards burnt and the whole downstairs is black with smoke
Muddy floodwater from the street came into the ground floor about half a metre deep
Wide diagonal cracks appeared over the doors after the dry summer and doors no longer close
Ice balls the size of golf balls broke our skylights and dented the gutters
Black mould on bedroom walls, we dry clothes indoors and the windows stream with condensation
Someone broke into the office through the back door, smashed partitions and stole computers
Water keeps dripping into the attic whenever it rains, the roofer says the flashing is rusty and old
Heavy snow made the flat roof of the garage sag and a beam cracked
Lightning hit the chimney and the roof timbers caught fire

irrelevant_queries: I lost my phone on the train
My car was scratched in a supermarket car park
Request to update my billing address
